title: Detector basis
description: monitor/detector-basis.json: the failure-mode class of each analyst, keyed on the id the corroboration joins use. loadBasisMap in monitor/detector-basis.mjs also refuses a detector naming a class `classes` does not declare and a class named `unclassified`, which this schema cannot express.

classes.description: Class id to the method and data source it names; a closed vocabulary.

detectors.description: Analyst id (a rollup finding's tool, or a scannerFindings category) to the class it belongs to.
